Docs.param: The non-null paint used for the replacement run.
The positive number of UTF-16 code units to replace, starting at the current offset. The run must not extend past the end of the paragraph.
a replacement width of the range. The units of this value are pixels. Value is 0.0f or greater
Docs.summary: Used to inform the text layout that the given length is replaced with the object of given width.
Docs.returns: This builder instance, with its current offset advanced by UTF-16 code units.

remarks.para: Used to inform the text layout that the given length is replaced with the object of given width. Keeps an internal offset which increases at every append. The initial value for this offset is zero. After the style is applied the internal offset is moved to offset + length, and next call will start from this new position. Informs the layout engine that the given length should not be processed, instead the provided width should be used for calculating the width of that range.
Style and replacement runs must together cover the complete paragraph before is called. The replacement's width is supplied by the caller; this method does not draw the replacement object.
For the run-length checks, see the Android 16 implementation.

MemberSignature.Value: .method public hidebysig instance class Android.Graphics.Text.MeasuredText/Builder SetComputeHyphenation(bool computeHyphenation) cil managed

Docs.param: true if you want to use automatic hyphenations.
Docs.summary: By passing true to this method, the build method will compute all possible hyphenation pieces as well.

remarks.para: This method was deprecated in API level 33. use setComputeHyphenation(int) instead.

By passing true to this method, the build method will compute all possible hyphenation pieces as well. If you don't want to use automatic hyphenation, you can pass false to this method and save the computation time of hyphenation. The default value is false. Even if you pass false to this method, you can still enable automatic hyphenation of LineBreaker but line break computation becomes slower.

Docs.param: a hyphenation mode. Value is one of the following: HYPHENATION_MODE_NONE; HYPHENATION_MODE_NORMAL; HYPHENATION_MODE_FAST
Docs.summary: Sets the mode used to compute hyphenation information when the paragraph is built.

remarks.para: Pass the integer value of to skip hyphenation computation, to compute it, or to use the faster algorithm. Only the fast mode ignores some shaping context, such as kerning around a hyphen. The default is no hyphenation computation.
If this builder was created from an existing , hyphenation computation must remain enabled or disabled as it was for that instance. Otherwise, fails.
See the mode selection and reuse checks in the Android 16 implementation.

If you don't use MeasuredText.getBounds(int,int,android.graphics.Rect), you can pass false to this method and save the memory spaces. The default value is true.
